turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, and I'd like to know why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
Okay. Who decided to enter that zero, and was anyone going to speak to Owen before it went in the gradebook?
Can I ask you something? How should teachers talk to parents like you? What works?
You're asking me how to do your job? Start with the zero, Hale. Who decided, and when?
What could I have said differently just now?
I'm not here to edit you, Hale. You haven't told me who decided, so I'm writing that down. The zero comes off, and then we talk.
